AnchorProps.name: items

DialogProps.name: onClose

DrawerProps.name: onClose
DrawerProps.description: Called when the drawer is closed

SwipeActionProps.description: Called when swiped right past threshold

ToastProps.name: title
ToastProps.description: Bold first line rendered above the message

ToastProps.name: onClose
ToastProps.description: Runs when the toast is dismissed (× button or countdown expiry)

ToastProps.name: duration
ToastProps.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms; 0 keeps the toast until dismissed

ToastProps.name: classNames

ThinkingIndicatorProps.name: text

TimePickerProps.name: minuteStep

TimePickerProps.name: secondStep
TimePickerProps.description: Second column step — only multiples of it are offered

TimePickerProps.name: use12Hours
TimePickerProps.description: Presents a 12-hour clock column plus an AM/PM column; the value stays 24-hour 'HH:mm[:ss]'

TimePickerProps.name: disabledTime
TimePickerProps.description: Disables candidate times on the columns; each candidate is judged against the currently selected parts of the other fields

TimePickerProps.name: native

TransferProps.name: targetKeys

TreeNodeData.name: disableCheckbox

TreeNodeData.name: isLeaf
TreeNodeData.description: Mark as leaf node (for lazy loading)

UploadProps.description: Selected files — local File picks mixed freely with UploadFile echo entries (files already on the server); uncontrolled (accumulating internally) when omitted

UploadProps.name: showUploadList
UploadProps.description: Renders the built-in file list below the zone: live progress, cancel while uploading, retry + remove on error, per-state actions

VirtualListProps.name: columnWidth

VirtualListProps.name: orientation
VirtualListProps.description: Scroll axis of the list; 'horizontal' mirrors windowing, dynamic measurement, scrollToIndex, reverse and sticky group headers onto the x axis with logical (RTL-aware) offsets

VirtualListProps.name: overscan
VirtualListProps.description: Extra items to render outside viewport

WatermarkProps.name: content

WatermarkProps.name: font

WatermarkProps.name: gap

WatermarkProps.name: offset
WatermarkProps.description: Offset of the tile grid origin, px

WatermarkProps.name: fullscreen
WatermarkProps.description: Cover the whole viewport (fixed layer) instead of the container

WatermarkProps.name: children
WatermarkProps.description: Content to watermark; with children the component acts as their container

CascaderProps.name: virtualized

CalendarProps.description: Prepend an ISO-8601 week-number column to the day grid

CalendarProps.name: months
CalendarProps.description: Render two adjacent month grids sharing navigation and range highlight

CalendarProps.name: rangeStart
CalendarProps.description: Highlight a range endpoint/in-between span (YYYY-MM-DD) without selecting

CalendarProps.name: rangeEnd
CalendarProps.description: Highlight a range endpoint/in-between span (YYYY-MM-DD) without selecting

CalendarProps.description: Appends custom content inside every picker cell (day numbers, month/quarter/year labels, drill-down grids) — receives the cell's civil date and the mode it renders in

PromptInputProps.name: tags

PromptInputProps.name: triggers

PromptInputProps.name: submitKey
